summary: Agent rows carry st's presentation (state word, group, why, now, next); the terminal UI reads it instead of deriving agent state

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. Agent rows gain an optional presentation object (AgentPresentation in client-v0.schema.json); the generated clients gain its types.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: The field is additive and optional, advertised by the presentation capability, version 1. This terminal UI reads presentation.state and because; for a row without one (an older daemon) it shows the state st reports, marked as from an older st, with a note on the agents list, and derives nothing. Upgrade daemons before clients. The phone and Fractal are unchanged in this release.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption. Each agent row read computes its presentation from fields of that row only, in the existing per-read overlay; a row it cannot read is served without one and logged.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or swap-back restrictions.
